newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU's Santer to meet both Chirac, Jospin.
newsitem.headline: EU's Santer to meet both Chirac, Jospin.

text.p: European Commission President Jacques Santer will meet both French President Jacques Chirac and Prime Minister Lionel Jospin on Thursday, officials said on Tuesday.
Their respective offices said Socialist Jospin would meet Santer at 9 a.m. (0700 GMT) and conservative Chirac would meet him an hour later.
Chirac and Jospin are sharing power in France since the left won parliamentary elections on June 1.

Santer's visit follows French Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn's announcement on Monday that Paris needed time to study a stability pact which is designed to enforce fiscal restraint in the European economic and monetary union (EMU).
